title: Kya Kahungi Sugra se
body:
Kya kahoo gi sughra se kya kahoo gi sughra se, nauha tha ye Zainab ka kya kahoo gi sughra se
Arbayeen karne ko aayi Zainab-e-kubra, sheh ki qabr par rokar kar rahi hai yeh nauha, kaise mu dikhaou gi puchey gi jo ye sughra, boliye puphi amma hai kaha mera baba
Uske dil me armaa tha shaadi main rachaoongi, byaah karke Akbar ka mai dulhan ko laoongi, bhai tere aaneki main duwa karaoongi, margaya tera bhai kaise mai bataooongi
Tazkera jo hoyega sheerqwar bachchey ka, usko yaad aaye ga uska phool sa chehra, jis ki yaad mein aksar wo jhulati thi jhula, kaise main dilasa doo kuch to boliye bhaiyya
<<DIVIDER>>
Pucheygi Sakina ko hai kaha meri qwahar, kya jawab de uskophir yeh Zainab-e-muztar, kistarah bataoongi kya sitam hua us par, Shaam ke anderey mein mar garyi wo ghut ghut kar
Bhai kaise batlau zulm jo huve hum par, baad tere marney ke hum hue barehna sar, haye kaisi gurbat thi dil pa chal gaye khanjar, laash par udane ko sar pa thi nahi chadar, bhai main watan ko ab laut karna jaoongi, haaley dil main sugra ko kis tarah bataoongi, poochey gi jo Asghar ko kuch bhi keh na paoongi, uska ghamzada chehra kaise dekh paoongi
Moosvi wo karti thi intezaar Akbar ka, dil mein thi yahi hasrath aaye ga mera bhaiyya, Karbala ko jaongi apne bhai ke hamrah, usko kya khabar bhaiyya uska chid gaya seena..
